suggested_change: Add explicit rules to CLAUDE.md: (1) Scores >5/10 on Metrics require direct prospect quote or reject; (2) Define 'competitor' as alternatives being actively evaluated, not tools being replaced; (3) Specify prohibited next-step keywords (e.g., 'monitor', 'explore', 'support'); (4) Flag unresolved data conflicts as conditional findings; (5) Require revision justification in status maintenance section when rescoring.
